what: Don’t paste images into the Doc
title: Writing a post from a Google Doc
text: paste insert image directly Google Doc (instead describing image_name: block), Google’s export embeds whole image base64 text, producing multi-hundred-KB unreadable .qmd. Always use image_name: block real image file Drive folder instead.

title: Download a Google Doc as a new blog post .qmd — google_doc_to_qmd
text: Downloads Google Doc Markdown, converts metadata block (Blog Title, Publish date, Authors, etc.) Quarto YAML front matter, saves result `index.qmd` inside new post folder, matching post-folder layout [crosspost_blog()] [verify_post_images()] expect. Image files referenced doc's `Image:` field body `image_name:` blocks downloaded doc's parent Drive folder post folder – doc images expected live together one Drive folder per post. See [download_doc_images()] details.

title: Download a Google Doc as a new blog post .qmd — google_doc_to_qmd
text: doc Google Drive file, anything [googledrive::as_id()] accepts – typically full share URL copied browser. post_name Name post folder create, e.g. "2026-09-09--title". Must start `YYYY-MM-DD` date (`-` `_` separated), used post's `date` part `citation.url` doc specify . blog_dir Path blog's root folder `post_name` created , e.g. "website-new/blog". base_url Base URL post published , e.g. "https://openscapes.org/blog/". Used build `citation.url` `<base_url><post_name>`. overwrite FALSE (default), errors post folder already exists. TRUE, replaces `index.qmd` inside .

title: Download a Google Doc as a new blog post .qmd — google_doc_to_qmd
text: Google Doc expected start metadata block plain-text lines, one field per line, e.g.: “` Blog Title: post title Publish date: Location: openscapes.org/blog, cross-post: URL: Authors: Ronny, Julie Image: description cover image Categories: blog, NASA “` Recognized fields consumed YAML front matter; everything first unrecognized line onward kept post body, except image placeholder blocks. See [parse_doc_header()] [build_qmd_front_matter()] header parsing rules. Anywhere body, three consecutive lines form: “` image_name: cover.jpg caption_text: caption describing image alt_text: longer accessible description image “` replaced centered Quarto figure div referencing `./<image_name>`. image file must already exist post folder – function create move . See [render_image_blocks()] details.
